programmes.d: John Smith´s third wife, Diane, can´t believe the allegations that her husband murdered his two previous wives.
When Wayne´s troubled history with women turns into a full-blown murder spree, he needs his brother to stop the madness.
Anthony Shores daughter Tiffany knows first-hand that her father is the worst kind of monster.
Dale Hausner´s brother Randy lives in fear of the random shooter stalking Phoenix at night never suspecting the killer is his own brother.
Brian Hummert´s son David is devastated when his mother is found murdered and terrified when a serial killer claims responsibility.
After a childhood of devastating abuse, Maureen sees there is something not quite right with her older sibling.
One of Ervil LeBarons 50 children, Anna grows up in one of the most notorious polygamist cults in American history.
Omar Mateen´s ex-wife Sitora struggles to break free of her husband´s abuse, but when he carries out a mass shooting she is drawn in again.
Drew Peterson´s son Stephen is in disbelief when his father is accused of murder in the suspicious death of his 3rd wife.
Richard Beasley´s daughter Tonya knows that her father has a shady past and is devastated to learn that her unwitting assistance has been used in the worst way.

The story of the tragic assault on the Branch Davidian compound in Texas and the subsequent efforts to determine the facts and assign blame. Shows how federal authorities misread cult leader David Koresh.
American Justice looks at some of the most notorious cases of police killings in recent times.

In the Depression-torn dust bowl of the 1930s, a new kind of desperado is born. Pretty Boy Floyd, John Dillinger, and Bonnie & Clyde become as well-known and admired as movie stars. Bill Kurtis narrates their murderous rise and deadly fall

The Prohibition Act of 1919 turns the petty vice and extortion gangs into criminal armies and helps sow the seeds of what will become the great crime syndicates. Brooklyn D.A. Charles Hynes is interviewed.
By the mid-1930s, law enforcement is outgunned and uncoordinated. Any state line provides a sanctuary for a fleeing hoodlum, setting the stage for a kidnapping wave.
The Mafia builds its own world--nightclubs, racetracks, and casinos--and climbs to the highest levels of power. Vito Genovese accompanies General Patton.
Shanti Cooper was murdered by her husband, who was seeking to benefit from life insurance and assets.
Byrd and Melanie Billings were murdered in 2009, during a robbery orchestrated by a former employee.
When Samira Frasch was found dead in her pool in Florida, police arrested her estranged husband.
In 2017, Makeva Jenkins was brutally murdered by her husband, who was motivated by an insurance payout.
In 2023, Alex Murdaugh was convicted of murdering his wife and son, linked to his financial crimes.
When Jerry 'Mike' Williams died in a boating accident, questions soon emerged about his wife Denise.
In 2015, the Smith family were brutally murdered in their home by a relative seeking to inherit their estate.
Lottery winner Abraham Shakespeare was murdered in 2009 by Dee Dee Moore, who sought to steal his fortune.
In 2011, a reclusive British millionaire was beaten to death by three men seeking his hidden fortune.
In a high-profile case, police discovered the remains of an aristocrat, leading them to his estranged wife.
Sydney went on a Tinder date with a girl named Audrey and never made it to work the next morning.
A gruesome Manhattan murder mystery where a Tech CEO was found dismembered in his lower east side apartment. Could the masked man on his elevator security camera be his murderer?
Grace went on a Tinder date with a man name Jesse who begged her for the date. Jesse was the last person to see Grace alive but he didn't know the CCTV cameras followed his every move.
